Messages.Author: Oortje
Messages.Body:
Just a few cornercase questions....You know what. Make it a quiz..

To pass the bridge thai shall awnser questions three. Three shall be
the number of questions to awnser. Bridge Keeperof monty Python's
holy grail (DUH!)

Situation 1
Minion A does an action and Minion B plays a Forced awakening to
block.
Minion A and B enter combat as a result of a block. Minion A plays
Form of Mist at superior to continue the action. There are no new
blocks and the action resolves succesfull. Does minion B Have to burn
1 blood for Forced Awakening for not succesfull blocking?

Situation 2
Minion A does an action and Minion B blocks.Minion A and B enter
combat as a result of a block. Minion A plays Form of Mist at superior
to continue the action. Minion B plays cats guidance at inferior to
Untap. Is this allowed?

Situation 3
Minion A is acting and enters combat with minion B. Minion A plays
coma + amarant, minion B is really scewed and gets burned. A bloodhunt
burns minion A. Minion A plays an abandoning the flesh. Is this
possible? In other words is a bloodhunt caused by amaranth still in
combat, since Abandoning the flesh can not be played as an
actionmodifier? (same goes for reform body)

Thanks in advance.
Oortje

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Oortje wrote:
> Just a few cornercase questions....You know what. Make it a quiz..
>
> To pass the bridge thai shall awnser questions three. Three shall be
> the number of questions to awnser. Bridge Keeperof monty Python's
> holy grail (DUH!)
>
> Situation 1
> Minion A does an action and Minion B plays a Forced awakening to
> block.
> Minion A and B enter combat as a result of a block. Minion A plays
> Form of Mist at superior to continue the action. There are no new
> blocks and the action resolves succesfull. Does minion B Have to burn
> 1 blood for Forced Awakening for not succesfull blocking?

No, because he successfully blocked.

> Situation 2
> Minion A does an action and Minion B blocks.Minion A and B enter
> combat as a result of a block. Minion A plays Form of Mist at superior
> to continue the action. Minion B plays cats guidance at inferior to
> Untap. Is this allowed?

Yes.

> Situation 3
> Minion A is acting and enters combat with minion B. Minion A plays
> coma + amarant, minion B is really scewed and gets burned. A bloodhunt
> burns minion A. Minion A plays an abandoning the flesh. Is this
> possible? In other words is a bloodhunt caused by amaranth still in

No.

> combat, since Abandoning the flesh can not be played as an
> actionmodifier? (same goes for reform body)

The bloodhunt it conducted independently of the surrounding combat and action.
No combat cards, action modifiers, or reaction cards may be played.
